pages.title: Crystallizer Spirits
pages.text: Crystallizer spirits are summoned to regenerate gem from their dusts and directly multiply$(br)the output of breaking gem ores. They will pick up appropriate items and drop the resulting into$(br)the world. A magical particle $()

pages.title: Crystallizer Spirits
pages.text: effect and a amethyst sound indicate the crystallizer is at work.$(br)

pages.title: Automation
pages.text: To ease automation, try summoning a $(l:summoning_rituals/summon_transport_items)Transporter Spirit$(/l) to place items from chests in the$(br) crystallizer's inventory, and a $(l:summoning_rituals/summon_cleaner)Janitor Spirit$(/l) to collect the processed items.$(br)

pages.title: Foliot Crystallizer
pages.text: The foliot crystallizer is the most basic crystallizer spirit.$(br2)It will crystallize in a very low speed.$(br)

pages.title: Filters
pages.text: This spirit already only picks up items it has recipes for.$(br)Put a $(item)list filter$() or $(item)attribute filter$() into its filter slot to further restrict which valid inputs it will take.$(br)See Spirit Filters for filter details.$()
